tuning.note: V8 --max-old-space-size=8192 is required so the old space can use the 8 GiB cgroup; default heap limits abort the resident ramp early. Disclose this when comparing. Ask Infinity whether a fair operator would set an analogous allocator knob (jemalloc/mimalloc, glibc MALLOC_*, arena sizing) — agent_scale today uses glibc malloc + malloc_trim(0) with no extra env.
